$comment: p15-oracle-077: tuning of the layout action families (screen, screenGroup, column, layout, split, resize, swap, move: every non-excluded id of plans/cmux-next/action-surfaces.json whose family_of is layout, 114 today, the design's 113 plus ids added since) for gen_actions.py (p15-oracle-071), which reads it as <family>/_tuning.json and keeps regeneration byte-stable. Each entry was reviewed against its handler (PaneHandlers, PaneHandlers+Verbs, TabHandlers, ScreenHandlers, ScreenAppearanceHandlers, ScreenGroupHandlers, GroupIconHandlers, ColumnHandlers, DockColumnHandlers, ColumnDocking, AppearanceHandlers, HistoryHandlers, BrowserHandlers, WindowMembershipHandlers, AppActions+Workspaces). Facet checks: the layout facet (tree, ratios, column widths, docks, active screen, focused and zoomed pane) for structure, the topology facet's panes for tab moves (it lists terminal tabs; the tabs facet lists only browser and page tabs), the sidebar rows for workspace order, settings.nonDefaultKeys for the two layout settings. a socket run without focus may not move focus or selection (FocusCoordinator.send refuses a changesView event), so the setup's splits and creates leave the launch's pane focused; the cases pick panes with focusPaneByNumber, a focus action. Not tuned: screenGroup.addScreen (an every-action-gaps.json gap, p15-oracle-082..087) and the four destructive ids the sweep never runs (screen.closeOthers, closeToLeft, closeToRight, screenGroup.close). Listed until their task lands: swapPaneRight, swapPaneDown and column.moveRight fail at a generated setup step (p15-oracle-330). Screen and screen-group metadata (color, icon, pin, group, collapsed, saved) is in no facet until p15-oracle-331: those cases check the receipt. Divergences filed: screen creates answer before the screen exists (p15-oracle-332); column presets on a lone split tree and Move Workspace Up/Down at the edge answer ok for nothing done (p15-oracle-333); an unknown saved screen group is daemon_error, not not_found (p15-oracle-334). Legacy registry.bind handlers report action.done, the screen name, color and pin intents action.applied, Split Browser action.waiting.
